role: Own bounded chemical check using actual primary textbook passages; no copied third-party tasks, images or source text

actualCurrentReads.title: John McMurry / OpenStax, Organic Chemistry, 25.6 Reactions of Monosaccharides
actualCurrentReads.passagesActuallyRead: Ring/open-chain equilibrium; basic copper reducing assay; glycoside restriction; fructose enediol rearrangement.
actualCurrentReads.ownBoundedUse: The text supports the stated relation between accessible sugar carbonyl forms and metal reduction. Its fructose example supports a possible alkaline rearrangement route. It does not establish glucose identity from a positive copper result.

actualCurrentReads.title: John McMurry / OpenStax, Organic Chemistry, 25.8 Disaccharides
actualCurrentReads.passagesActuallyRead: Free anomeric hemiacetal in maltose; both anomeric centres linked in sucrose.
actualCurrentReads.ownBoundedUse: The reducing-end comparison supports the current maltose-versus-sucrose transfer. The result concerns the specified assay conditions, rather than a universal assertion that sucrose can never become reducing after chemical treatment.

actualCurrentReads.title: John McMurry / OpenStax, Organic Chemistry, 26.1 Structures of Amino Acids
actualCurrentReads.passagesActuallyRead: Ionic backbone, zwitterions, acid/base response, side-chain classification and glutamic-acid groups/pKa table.
actualCurrentReads.ownBoundedUse: The shared ionisable groups prevent inference of universal insolubility from a hydrocarbon side chain. Side-chain categories describe chemical functionality; whole-molecule charge remains necessary when explaining free-amino-acid observations.

actualCurrentReads.title: John McMurry / OpenStax, Organic Chemistry, 26.2 Amino Acids and the Henderson–Hasselbalch Equation: Isoelectric Points
actualCurrentReads.passagesActuallyRead: pH−pKa as logarithm of deprotonated/protonated ratio; mixtures and dominant forms.
actualCurrentReads.ownBoundedUse: The equation checks dominant species without asserting complete protonation or equating a dominant neutral species with exactly zero mean charge. The later protein-solubility discussion is not used as a quantitative free-glutamic-acid solubility source.

ownNumericalModelCheck.modelBoundary: Use the rounded pKa values supplied by the fictional task. The normalised three-step species model is an additional explanatory check, not measured solution composition or activity-corrected speciation.
ownNumericalModelCheck.loadingBoundary: 10 g/L is supplied total loading, not a measured or inferred numerical saturation solubility. Solid/no-solid observations cannot isolate counterion, ionic-strength and crystal effects.

curriculumScope.unchangedConclusion: The previously read HE Q2 basic route supports reducing assays and disaccharide reasoning; the separate elevated/LK clause supplies the fructose/keto-enol extension. No universal basic-route fructose requirement is inferred.
curriculumScope.otherJurisdictions: No new clause reads or whole-country/course coverage claims. Applicability tags and metadata are not scientific source proof.

licensesAndProvenance: External pages are cited only for a bounded fact check. No external image, assessment, source text or task is incorporated or relicensed. The existing own fictional case materials remain at their original provenance and license.
